question.text: What is the applicable NAV cut-off time for purchase of liquid fund and overnight fund units?

explanation.text: The Logic: For purchases in liquid and overnight funds the cut-off time is 1:30 PM. Where the application is received and the funds are realised before this cut-off on a business day, the applicable NAV is the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding the day of receipt of the application — not the same day's closing NAV. The Trap: The 1:30 PM cut-off relates to which NAV applies, not to a "same-day" NAV — the source workbook gives an example where a Monday liquid-fund purchase realised by 1 PM uses Sunday's NAV. Note: Source: NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) workbook, pp.190-192 — 1:30 PM cut-off for liquid/overnight fund purchases; applicable NAV is the closing NAV of the day immediately preceding receipt of the valid application/funds.
